top_signals.title: Myspace eyes comeback as an 'antidote' to social media fatigue — but it may be a long shot
top_signals.summary: "Excitement about Myspace's relaunch reflects nostalgia for a more analog time, when algorithms were less dominant in our lives," an analyst told CNBC.

top_signals.title: TOTE Services Hosts Medium Landing Ship (LSM) Industry Day
top_signals.summary: TOTE Services, LLC, a leading U.S. maritime services company specializing in vessel construction management and ship management, hosted more than 30 commercial shipbuilders, equipment manufacturers, marine suppliers, and defense contractors…
